generated.readme:
UPAKUAJI WA SEHEMU NYINGI
===================
Tovuti hii imegawanywa katika sehemu {{total}} kwa ajili ya kupakuliwa.

MAAGIZO YA KUTOA:
1. Pakua sehemu zote {{total}} (faili zinazoishia na .zip)
2. Unda folda mpya ya tovuti
3. Toa kila faili ya ZIP kwenye folda HIYO HIYO
4. Faili zote zitaungana katika muundo sahihi wa saraka
5. Fungua index.html ili kutazama tovuti

Hii ni Sehemu ya {{part}} kati ya {{total}}

pagepocketAnnouncement.description: Hifadhi ukurasa wowote wa wavuti kwenye hazina yako ya wingu ya kibinafsi. Fikia kurasa zako zilizohifadhiwa kutoka popote, zitafute mara moja na zishiriki kwa kiungo.

tab.unsupportedDescription: Website Downloader works on regular web pages (http and https). Browser settings pages, the Chrome Web Store and local files are not supported. Open a website in this tab to start a download.

welcome.title: Welcome to Web Page Downloader
welcome.subtitle: Save any web page as a ZIP archive — HTML, images, styles and scripts — right from your browser.
welcome.feature1: Capture complete pages, including images, CSS and JavaScript
welcome.feature2: Save pages to your computer as a ZIP, or to PagePocket cloud storage
welcome.feature3: Browse the archived page offline at any time
welcome.step1Description: Click the extension icon in the toolbar and select "Open side panel".
welcome.step2Description: Choose what to capture — full HTML, images, assets or a single file.
welcome.step3Description: Press "Start download" and get a ZIP archive you can open offline.
welcome.ctaHint: Tip: you can also right-click the extension icon and choose "Open side panel".
